get.description:
Unauthenticated 200. Does NOT touch the database — it is a pure
liveness signal so the app reports healthy even if Postgres is
unreachable (DB connectivity is per-request, architecture §1).

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

post.description:
Establish a session: mint an access token + set the HttpOnly refresh
cookie. Non-enumerating 401 for a wrong identifier OR password; 423 (with
`retry_after_seconds`) while locked; 403 for inactive accounts (api-spec §2.3).

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and re-issue an access token (api-spec §2.3)
post.description:
Cookie-only auth + the custom `X-Refresh: 1` header (CSRF defense, §2.2).
Validates + ROTATES the refresh session. On ANY failure → 401 refresh_invalid
AND the cookie is cleared.

NOTE: every failure path RETURNS a `JSONResponse` (rather than raising) so the
clearing `Set-Cookie` is attached to the response that is actually sent. If we
raised, FastAPI would route to the global handler and DISCARD this `response`
object — the clearing cookie would never reach the browser (api-spec §2.3
requires a refresh failure to clear the cookie).

Authenticated; revoke the refresh session named by the cookie and clear it.
Idempotent — an already-logged-out caller still gets 204.

get.summary: The signed-in user's identity, role and preferences (api-spec §2.3)
get.description: Resolve the CurrentUser payload (profile ids + preferences).

patch.description:
Self only. `current_password` required UNLESS must_change_password is set.
New password is validated against the policy → 422 weak_password. On success,
all OTHER refresh sessions are revoked (the current one is kept).

post.description:
Principal/Secretary reset another user. A Secretary may NOT reset a
Principal (403); cannot reset self (409 cannot_reset_self); unknown target
(404 user_not_found). Returns a generated temporary password ONCE.

get.description: Authenticated read — every role needs identity for report headers.

put.description: Principal only (Secretary read-only per matrix). Audited.

post.summary: Upload the school logo (principal, multipart; api-spec §5.11)
post.description:
Principal only; multipart/form-data image.

NOTE: real object-storage upload is stubbed — see service.upload_logo
TODO(OQ-DB5). Validation (415 unsupported_media_type, 413 file_too_large) is
real; the endpoint returns {logo_url} (None until storage is provisioned).

get.description:
Authenticated. 409 no_active_semester is the uniform system-wide degrade
signal (fresh install or only-active-year just archived).

get.summary: All academic years + their semesters (P/S; api-spec §5.11)

post.summary: Create an academic year + exactly 2 semesters (principal; api-spec §5.11)
post.description:
Principal. Creates EXACTLY 2 semesters (D10), seeds grading scale + default
bands (D11). 409 active_year_exists when an active year already exists.

get.summary: Semesters, optionally filtered by year (P/S; api-spec §5.11)

patch.summary: Activate a semester (principal; one-active invariant; api-spec §5.11)
patch.description: Principal. Clears the prior active semester, sets this one active.

post.description:
Principal. State transitions + idempotency guard implemented; snapshot
COMPUTATION is stubbed (TODO(7.6/7.8), see service). 409 year_already_archived
if already archived.

get.summary: The grading scale + bands (authenticated; default active; api-spec §5.11)
get.description: Authenticated — Grades/Reports/SPA need it to display letters.

put.summary: Update the grading scale (principal; api-spec §5.11, FR-SET-03/06)
put.description:
Principal (Secretary cannot, FR-SET-04). 422 grading_bands_invalid on
non-contiguous bands; 409 scale_frozen on a frozen scale.

put.summary: Update the school-default grading policy (principal; api-spec §5.11)

post.summary: Create a user login (P/S; principal-only for privileged roles; §5.11)
post.description:
P/S may create teacher/student logins; assigning principal/secretary is
Principal-only (403 role_change_forbidden). 409 duplicate_email. New users get
must_change_password=true; a generated temp password is returned ONCE.

patch.summary: Update a user (P for role/active; P/S for benign edits; §5.11)
patch.description:
role/is_active are Principal-only; a Secretary cannot edit a Principal (403).
Audited on role/active changes.

patch.summary: Update own contact info + preferences (authenticated self; §5.11)

get.description:
Everyone may read the catalog (reference data, no PII). Default is_active
filter hides retired subjects from the picker.

patch.description: Edits name/code/is_active. Renaming is safe for history (frozen subject_id).

delete.summary: Soft-delete a subject if unused (P/S; api-spec §5b)
delete.description:
Soft-delete only if no class_subjects offering references it; else 409
subject_in_use (retire via PATCH is_active=false instead).

get.description:
Teacher results auto-restrict to students in a section they own any subject
of (FR-STU-08). Students are denied at the role gate (403).

post.description:
Optionally enrolls into `section_id` for the active semester in one txn.
409 duplicate_student_number / section_archived / no_active_semester.

get.summary: The signed-in student's own profile (student; api-spec §5.3, FR-STU-09)
get.description:
Server-derived scope: the profile is resolved from the token, never a param
(§3.2). 404 no_student_profile if the login isn't linked to a student.

Teacher must own a section the student is enrolled in, else 404 (§3.3).
Students are denied at the role gate (403 → use /students/me).

patch.summary: Update a student's profile (P/S; api-spec §5.3, FR-STU-03)
patch.description:
`status` is NOT editable here — use POST /students/{id}/status. Re-checks
student_number uniqueness on change.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a student if no academic history (P/S; §5.3, FR-STU-10)
delete.description:
Blocked if any grade/attendance references the student (FK RESTRICT) → 409
has_academic_history (deactivate instead).

get.summary: Assessments for the student's section subjects (P/S/Teacher; §5.3)
get.description:
Teacher must own a section the student is in, else 404. (A student self uses
GET /assessments?scope=me in the Assessments module.)

schema.title: Response List Student Assessments Api V1 Students  Student Id  Assessments Get

post.summary: Change a student's lifecycle status (P/S; api-spec §5.3, FR-STU-04)
post.description:
Auditable, guarded lifecycle change. 422 invalid_transition on an illegal
move (FR-STU-04).

get.description: Read-only for teachers; students are denied at the gate (403).

post.description:
409 duplicate_staff_number / duplicate_email. `create_login` provisions a
linked teacher account; its temp password is returned ONCE.

patch.summary: Update a teacher's profile (P/S; api-spec §5.4, FR-TCH-03)
patch.description:
Benign profile edits only. Deactivation = POST /teachers/{id}/status
(Principal-only).

delete.summary: Soft-delete a teacher if unassigned (Principal; §5.4, FR-TCH-03/06)
delete.description:
Blocked if assigned to any active class_subject (FK RESTRICT) → 409
teacher_has_active_assignments.

post.description:
Deactivating a teacher with active class_subject assignments is blocked →
409 teacher_has_active_assignments (with offending refs, FR-TCH-06).

AcademicYearCreateRequest.title: AcademicYearCreateRequest
AcademicYearCreateRequest.description:
POST /settings/academic-years — service creates EXACTLY 2 semesters (D10).

The two provided semesters must carry sequence 1 and 2 (schema enforces
`sequence IN (1,2)` + the per-year uniqueness on sequence).

AcademicYearList.title: AcademicYearList
AcademicYearList.description: GET /settings/academic-years — not paginated; a school has few years.

AccountUpdateRequest.title: AccountUpdateRequest
AccountUpdateRequest.description: PATCH /settings/account (self). Contact info on the user + preferences.

ActiveTerm.title: ActiveTerm
ActiveTerm.description: The global semester switcher payload. 409 no_active_semester when absent.

ClassTaught.title: ClassTaught
ClassTaught.description: One (section, subject) offering this teacher is assigned to (D23).

CurrentUser.title: CurrentUser
CurrentUser.description:
GET /auth/me + login/refresh `user`. Byte-for-byte matches the frontend's
`CurrentUser` (shared/types/api.ts).

GradingBand.title: GradingBand
GradingBand.description:
A single contiguous band. Read + write share this shape; on write the
service validates contiguity over 0..100 (no gaps/overlaps, schema §5).

GradingScaleUpdateResponse.title: GradingScaleUpdateResponse
GradingScaleUpdateResponse.description:
200 body of PUT /settings/grading-scale. `affects_displayed_grades` warns
the SPA that derive-on-read letters change going forward (FR-SET-06).

SchoolProfileRead.title: SchoolProfileRead
SchoolProfileRead.description:
GET /settings/school — SchoolIdentity plus nothing extra (identity is the
public read shape). `logo_url` is resolved from `logo_storage_key` + the
Supabase public base when a key is present (TODO(OQ-DB5), see service).

StudentAssessmentItem.title: StudentAssessmentItem
StudentAssessmentItem.description:
GET /students/{id}/assessments item (api-spec §5.3, FR-ASMT-06).

A student-detail-scoped assessment summary carrying exactly the fields the
api-spec `AssessmentSummary` enumerates. Defined locally (not imported from an
Assessments-module schema) because that module is not built yet; the Students
endpoint reads assessments for the subjects in the student's section directly.

StudentCreateRequest.title: StudentCreateRequest
StudentCreateRequest.description:
POST /students (api-spec §5.3, FR-STU-01/02/05).

`status` is accepted here (defaults active). Lifecycle CHANGES after creation
go through POST /students/{id}/status — not PATCH. `section_id`, if present,
enrolls the student into that section for the active semester in the same
transaction.

StudentDetail.title: StudentDetail
StudentDetail.description:
GET /students/{id}, /students/me + POST/PATCH/status responses.

Mirrors `student_profiles` (schema §3.B) plus the derived `current_section`
(the student's active section for the active semester) and the audit stamp.

StudentUpdateRequest.title: StudentUpdateRequest
StudentUpdateRequest.description:
PATCH /students/{id} (api-spec §5.3, FR-STU-03).

All fields optional (partial update). `status` is intentionally ABSENT — it is
NOT editable here; lifecycle goes through the dedicated status endpoint
(auditable, guarded). `section_id` is likewise not a PATCH field — enrollment/
transfer is a Classes-module action.

TeacherCreateResponse.title: TeacherCreateResponse
TeacherCreateResponse.description:
201 body of POST /teachers. `temporary_password` is returned ONCE, only when
a linked login was provisioned and the server generated its password.

TeacherLoginProvision.title: TeacherLoginProvision
TeacherLoginProvision.description:
Optional linked-account provisioning on teacher create (D5, admin-provisioned).

Role is fixed to `teacher` (a teacher profile links to a teacher login only).
The generated temporary password is returned ONCE on the create response.

TeacherUpdateRequest.title: TeacherUpdateRequest
TeacherUpdateRequest.description:
PATCH /teachers/{id} (api-spec §5.4, FR-TCH-03).

Benign profile edits only. `status` (deactivation) goes through
POST /teachers/{id}/status (Principal-only); role change is a Settings action.

UserCreateResponse.title: UserCreateResponse
UserCreateResponse.description:
201 body of POST /settings/users. `temporary_password` is returned ONCE,
only when the server generated it (never echoed if the admin supplied one).

UserUpdateRequest.title: UserUpdateRequest
UserUpdateRequest.description:
PATCH /settings/users/{id}. All fields optional; only role/is_active are
privileged (principal-only). Benign profile edits (full_name) are P/S.
